name: Back Alley Beatdown
detailed_description:
Overview

Back Alley Beatdown is an indie 2D platform fighting game with Roguelike elements set in a dystopian world where andromorphic creatures duke it out in battles using any underhanded tricks and tactics to become the champion of the streets!

Game Features

  • Choose VERSUS MODE to fight in 1v1 duals with your friends were after you lose your stocks you get a new upgrade.

  • Boot up PRACTICE MODE to hone your skills and practice your moves.

  • Play STAGE WARP where the map switches randomly after each round.

Fighters

Mr. Midnight

A sneaky feline with a mean streak, Mr. Midnight robs and attacks for profit. He wields a long chain tipped with a spiked ball to keep enemies at bay, and if things get too close, he's got a brass knuckle ready to finish the job. He doesn't care who you are civilian or royalty, if you've got something valuable, you're a target. To escape trouble or scout undetected, he can transform into a regular house cat and vanish into the crowd.

Scapolite Vulture

Wingless but far from helpless, Scapolite Vulture tears through enemies with his hook-shaped beak and razor-sharp claws. What he lacks in flight, he makes up for in pure speed darting across the stage with relentless aggression. At the center of his forehead rests a mysterious scapolite gem, pulsing with power. It fuels his strength and gives him a fearsome presence in battle. Quick, vicious, and unshakably focused, Scapolite Vulture isn't here to soar, he's here to shred.

Doctor Mara

Once a brilliant medical mind, Doctor Mara vanished without a trace. Rumors swirled, but the truth was darker, a cursed force twisted her body and soul. Now, she lurks within missing posters, emerging only when she senses a nearby presence. Those unlucky enough to cross her path rarely escape. Her body is a blend of flesh and machine, a scalpel for one arm, a crushing clamp for the other. Her wheelchair has become part of her, its wheels replacing her legs entirely. Though her face is disfigured and her eyes blind, her hearing is razor sharp making her even more dangerous in silence. Doctor Mara doesn't heal anymore she hunts.

Estra the Magical Girl

Hailing from the far reaches of space, Estra is an alien sorceress who commands electricity, lightning, and plasma with terrifying precision. Her attacks crackle with raw energy, striking fast and unpredictably across the battlefield. Estra's power is channeled through a wand that keeps her unstable abilities in check. With it, she fights with deadly grace controlling storms and bending energy to her will. Without it, she becomes a living disaster, unleashing uncontrollable lightning that threatens to destroy everything around her. Beautiful, dangerous, and barely restrained, Estra is a cosmic force wrapped in chaos.

Moxie the Sand Bender

Born in the heart of the desert, Moxie brings the fury of the dunes to the city streets. She controls sand with expert precision using it to blind opponents, slow their movement, or strike from a distance. But sand is only the beginning. Through intense heat and pressure, Moxie forges deadly glass weapons mid-fight razor sharp and unpredictable. Every battle is her battlefield, shaped grain by grain. With grit, skill, and a fierce drive, she fights toward her mysterious goal turning the city into her own shifting arena.

short_description: Back Alley Beatdown is a 2D Platform Fighter with Roguelike elements. In this dystopian world you must fight to survive by any means necessary. Use your skills and any underhanded tricks to challenge your friends to fun and exhilarating combat to find out who the true champion of the streets is!
